blocks.html: Enterprising. Creative. Artistic. These are the words that best encapsulate the 39 hardworking and inspired entrepreneurs who are part of the 8th Made in QC Artisan’s Fair, an initiative of the Quezon City Tourism Department. Showcased are creations – food and non-food items of: Clara Scents, Little Baboo Handcrafted Candle Manufacturing,Little John,Lit Candle Co.Hard Pots, Plural & Co,Rolls Dessert Kitchen, Bathgems, Pure and Supple,Amore Blooms,Pik-A-Pikel Green Palette,Happy Life Organics,Forest Magic & Bioneem, ETS Wadoughs Patisserie,Neil & Marter, Bag’ito, Jumimo Enterprises, Maria Ceramika, Cactus & Canvas, Silent Beads, Papemelroti, Likhang Atin by CCAP Fairtrade for Development Inc,Disteleria Limtuaco & Co. Inc, Chickenstop PH, South sea Gems Jewelry Manufacturing, Muli, Karabella Dairy, The Indoor Wetlands, Ann Casas Designs, Kyusified Livelihood, Mjoran, Joy of Urban Farming, The Sourdough Bread House, Bee Republic, Moonleaf Tea Shop, Papa Diddi’s Ice Cream, Dimension Artisan Chocolate, & The Kitchen Wrap.
Top QC officials were present during the formal opening led by Irene Belmonte, QC Councilor 4th Distric. The Artisan Fair will run until December 19 at the Atrium of Robinsons Magnolia.
